title: KoMultiText: Large-Scale Korean Text Dataset for Classifying Biased Speech in Real-World Online Services
reasoning: The paper focuses on detecting and classifying various types of biases (gender, political, racial, etc.) and profanity in online comments to improve online community health. It does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religious/faith-based content, moral frameworks, or ethical principles as a core component. The mentions of 'societal well-being' are general benefits of mitigating hate speech, not a direct evaluation of faith/ethics.
